response.sql:
WITH per_timespan AS (
  SELECT o.timespan,
         AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
threshold AS (
  SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_match_count
  FROM per_timespan
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT p.avg_ratio, p.match_count, t.avg_match_count
  FROM per_timespan AS p
  CROSS JOIN threshold AS t
  WHERE p.match_count > t.avg_match_count
)
SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_group_avg_ratios,
       SUM(match_count) AS total_match_count,
       AVG(match_count - avg_match_count) AS avg_excess_match_count
FROM qualifying;

assumptions.assumption: A match count is the number of joined fee–order rows in each time-in-force group; ratio averages ignore NULL ratios, and SQLite also treats division by zero as NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: If a match count should count distinct matched orders, while retaining the average ratio across fee rows, use COUNT(DISTINCT order reference) for the group counts.
